The literal meaning of Lothal is 'place of the dead'. Lothal is the only Indus site where an artificial brick dockyard was found and the dockyard must have served as the main seaport for the people of Indus. Lothal is known as Manchester town of Harappan civilisation because of its expansion of cotton trade. Furnaces of copper, Persian Gulf seal (a circular button shaped seal), one or two terracotta models of Egyptian mummies wrapped with muslin cloth, a figurine of a horse related to terracotta model, evidence of chess, circular and square fire altar, two-faced monster marking on rice and millet, three paired mausoleum complete ivory, sign of a cunning fox have found from here.
